items.briefing:
Google has warned that AI is increasingly being used to launch more sophisticated cyber attacks, while a separate incident showed an AI agent breaching a Spanish organisation and modifying personal data — a reminder that AI tools carry real security risks. Locally, an Australian bank has moved to block staff from sharing confidential data with public AI tools like ChatGPT, a sensible precaution as AI use grows across workplaces.

Australia has also joined international efforts to combat scams through the Global Signal Exchange anti-scam alliance. **Practical tip:** Avoid entering confidential work information into public AI tools — use only employer-approved platforms for sensitive tasks.
